question: Has Benvolio been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Benvolio now?
markdown:
Depending on which entity you mean by "Benvolio," it either refers to the investment firm
Benvolio Group
, the Italian wine brand
Benvolio
(owned by Jackson Family Wines), or the Italian food/oil brand
Benvolio 1938
(run by the Dal Sasso family). None of these have record of being newly merged or acquired away from their primary parent structures.
BENVOLIO.BIO
Benvolio Group (Investment Firm)
Status:
Active independent venture capital/investment firm.
Ownership:
Co-founded and owned by Lew Frankfort (former CEO of Coach Inc.) and Sam Frankfort as a family investment vehicle. It has not merged or been acquired.
Startup Intros
Benvolio Wines (Italian Winery)
Status:
Under the corporate umbrella of
Jackson Family Wines
Ownership:
Owned and operated as part of the Jackson Family Wines portfolio.
Benvolio 1938 (Organic Oils and Foods)
Status:
Independent historical brand.
Ownership:
Managed and controlled by the founding Dal Sasso family, continuing four generations of tradition.
